analysis.reading: The heteronym resolves as a heteronym of the archive, placed in the Dodecad. Both works named are real: 14.CHAMBER.THOUSANDWORLDS (#14, creator 'Sen Kuro (Primary Operative)'; Zenodo creators Kuro, Sen and Sharks, Lee) with its Dagger Logic, and the Diversity Contraction boundary law. The second carries a split attribution. The archive registry seats #779 under Nobel Glas alone; the Zenodo metadata for the later versions in the family (Fear and Trembling; The Bead Count) lists four creators — Sharks, Fraction, Glas, Kuro — and the composition credits the work to Kuro. It follows the platform's creator line and keeps the Zenodo records as live sources, although the archive's Zenodo account was severed.
